title: Digital Content Creator
description: Digital Content Creator — Addis Ababa Full-time, Creative Team / Marketing We're looking for someone to sit inside our creative team and keep a steady stream of short-form content moving — for our clients' brands, not a personal channel. You'll get briefs from the account and strategy side, but we don't want someone who just executes literally. Read the brief, see three better ways to do it, and pitch those too. Day to day, you're producing short-form content across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts for client accounts. A brief always has gaps — the actual hook, the actual pacing, the actual shot list — and filling those in well is most of the job. Some days that means shooting: simple setups, sometimes with talent, sometimes just you in front of the camera representing a brand's voice rather than your own. You're scripting, filming, handling basic lighting and audio, and carrying the piece through to the final edit yourself. You'll work closely with the account and strategy side to understand what a client's brand actually sounds like, and that's harder than it sounds — you're adjusting your instincts to someone else's voice, repeatedly, across different accounts, and getting it wrong reads as generic. You're also expected to have real opinions about what's working on which platform and bring ideas into planning meetings, not just wait to be told what to make. What you need to have already done: 1–3 years producing content professionally, ideally for brands or clients rather than just a personal account. Send examples of work you made for someone else's brand voice; your personal feed doesn't tell us what we need to know. You should have shot and edited short-form video start to finish on your own, and be able to talk through why something you made actually performed the way it did. If you're looking for a role where you wait for a brief and execute exactly what's written, this isn't it. We want someone who takes a brief, finds a better version of it, and then goes and makes it. To apply: Send your CV and portfolio to alazark@krinfud.com . Your portfolio needs to show client or brand work, not just personal content — applications without that won't be considered.

It provides public, private and non-governmental organisations with the knowledge and tools that enable human progress, economic development and nature conservation to take place together. Created in 1948, IUCN is now the world’s largest and most diverse environmental network, harnessing the knowledge, resources and reach of more than 1,400 Member organisations and around 15,000 experts. It is a leading provider of conservation data, assessments and analysis. Its broad membership enables IUCN to fill the role of incubator and trusted repository of best practices, tools and international standards. IUCN provides a neutral space in which diverse stakeholders including governments, NGOs, scientists, businesses, local communities, indigenous peoples organisations and others can work together to forge and implement solutions to environmental challenges and achieve sustainable development. Working with many partners and supporters, IUCN implements a large and diverse portfolio of conservation projects worldwide. Combining the latest science with the traditional knowledge of local communities, these projects work to reverse habitat loss, restore ecosystems and improve people’s well-being. www.iucn.org https://twitter.com/IUCN/ About The Project The project focuses on promoting catchment protection through Nature-based Solutions (NbS), framed as best adaptive practices in the context of climate change and increasing land degradation.
